name: Omaherdr
author: Neil Patel
description: TUI-style panel for herdr: every session you are attached to from this desktop, its spaces, tabs and agents with live status, and one keypress to jump to any of them.

barWidget.description: Agents waiting for input or done in the bar; a panel listing spaces, tabs and agents across every attached herdr (local or --remote) that jumps to the right terminal window and target.

schema.label: Text shown beside the icon
schema.description: attention = agents needing input (!) and done (✓), hidden when there are none; all = also working (⠴) and idle (·); none = icon only.

schema.label: Bar icon
schema.description: A name (robot, robot-happy, console, terminal, brain, group, dashboard, flag, bell, server, lan, chip, pulse) or any Nerd Font glyph.

schema.label: Panel view
schema.description: agents = one row per agent, most urgent first; spaces = every space with its tabs.
